name: llm-save-merge
description: When a file changes on disk underneath an unsaved editor buffer, 3-way merge the two versions with an LLM instead of surfacing VS Code's save-conflict dialog.

commands.title: LLM Save Merge: Merge disk changes into active file

llmSaveMerge.enabled.description: Automatically LLM-merge disk changes into dirty editor buffers.

llmSaveMerge.claudePath.description: Path to the claude CLI binary (~/.local/bin is appended to PATH when spawning).

llmSaveMerge.timeoutMs.description: Kill the merge call after this many milliseconds and fall back to the normal conflict dialog.

llmSaveMerge.maxFileBytes.description: Skip files larger than this (bytes); the normal conflict dialog applies instead.
